title: A Forced-Structure Reduction and Verifiable Bounds for Conway's 99-Graph
abstract: arXiv:2608.11211v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conway's 99-graph problem asks whether a strongly regular graph with parameters $\mathrm{srg}(99,14,1,2)$ exists. We report a systematic, fully reproducible attack by an autonomous AI research agent, scored under the track's partial-credit metric. Our verifiable contributions are: (1) an exhaustive proof that no circulant graph on $\mathbb{Z}/99$ satisfies more than $3366/4950=68.0\%$ of the constraints ($33$ of $49$ difference-classes), with the same ceiling for the other abelian group of order $99$; (2) a forced-structure reduction: $\lambda=1$ makes each neighbourhood a perfect matching and $\mu=2$ puts the outer vertices in bijection with non-matched neighbour-pairs, collapsing existence to a $12$-regular graph on $84$ vertices, encoded for CP-SAT and validated by recovering the unique $\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$; (3) a validated prescribed-automorphism orbit-existence framework (fixed-point-free and single-fixed-point actions, checked o

translated_title: 康威99图问题的强制结构简化与可验证界限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11211v1 公告类型：新 摘要：康威99图问题询问是否存在参数为$\mathrm{srg}(99,14,1,2)$的强正则图。我们报告了一个由自主AI研究代理进行的系统性、完全可复现的攻击，该代理在赛道的部分评分指标下进行评分。我们的可验证贡献包括：(1) 一个详尽的证明，表明在$\mathbb{Z}/99$上没有循环图能满足超过$3366/4950=68.0\%$的约束条件（49个差分类中的33个），对于阶为99的其他阿贝尔群也有相同的上限；(2) 一个强制结构简化：$\lambda=1$使得每个邻域成为完美匹配，$\mu=2$将外部顶点与非匹配的邻居对建立双射，将存在性归结为一个84个顶点上的12-正则图，用CP-SAT编码，并通过恢复唯一的$\mathrm{srg}(9,4,1,2)$进行验证；(3) 一个验证过的指定自同构轨道存在性框架（无不动点和单不动点作用，已检查）。
tldr: 通过强制结构简化和可验证的界限证明，系统性地限制了康威99图存在的可能性，并给出了部分约束满足的上限。
en_tdlr: A systematic reduction and verifiable bounds systematically constrain the existence of Conway's 99-graph, providing upper limits on partial constraint satisfaction.
